Network Overview

Our AI matching engine analyzes three distinct clusters of the innovation ecosystem:

  • AI/ML & Enterprise — OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face connecting with top talent and enterprise investors (Sequoia, a16z)
  • Cloud Infrastructure — Databricks, HashiCorp, Snyk with DevOps experts and infrastructure-focused VCs
  • Climate Tech & Sustainability — Commonwealth Fusion, Twelve, Form Energy with climate investors (Breakthrough Energy)
  • Enterprise Players — Google AI, AWS, Tesla Energy providing strategic partnerships and resources
